model: See resolved_config.json for fixed generator/judge and hardware.

definitions.answer_correctness: LLM judge on answerable questions; refusals count 0; judge errors excluded and counted.
definitions.groundedness: LLM judge on published answers using only cited source excerpts; fallible.
definitions.citation_accuracy: Deterministic gold-source citation precision across unique references in published answers; source relevance proxy, not claim entailment.
definitions.citation_support_judge: Separate semantic claim/source support judgment; fallible.
definitions.answerability: Positive=published non-abstaining answer; FAR=FP/negative gold, FRR=FN/positive gold.
definitions.input_tokens: API-reported counts; local Ollama prompt_eval_count can reflect prompt-cache computation.
definitions.estimated_cost_usd: Configured API token prices only; local compute/electricity is not priced.
